name: mp-host-join
title: Two peers through the real lobby UI: host options, ready, start, play, End Match, rematch, leave

checklist.what: the multiplayer landing shows the name prompt, Host, Join, Resume and Replays
host setup shows the activity, scene and mode pickers, the port and the player count
all six host options pages (Seats, Rules, Network, Recovery, Files, Session) are opened and drawn inside the panel, before the session and again from the lobby
checklist.assert: menu script: assert_visible CollectionBoxHostPage<page> 1 plus dump_host_options per page

checklist.what: the host's lobby lists both seats, the picked activity and mode, and the connection state
checklist.assert: menu script: assert_substate Lobby after wait_connected 2

checklist.what: the joiner reaches the same lobby through Join and sees the same match line
checklist.assert: menu script: assert_substate Lobby after ButtonMultiplayerConnect

checklist.what: the client's Options opens MATCH DETAILS with Apply disabled and no editable row
checklist.assert: menu script: assert_label LabelHostOptionsTitle M A T C H   D E T A I L S and assert_enabled ButtonHostOptApply 0

checklist.what: both seats read ready and Start begins the match
checklist.assert: menu script: wait_all_ready then activate ButtonMultiplayerStart

checklist.what: 600+ ticks of real play on both peers: actors move, aim and fire, and the two videos agree frame for frame in what the world does
checklist.assert: input script tools/e2e/play-input.txt on both peers

checklist.what: the in-match pause menu shows Leave Match, Match Options, Settings and End Match; End Match is enabled on the host and disabled on the client
the pause Match Options dialog is inside the viewport and Repair is offered to the host only
End Match stops the round on both peers without an error dialog
both peers land back in the lobby with the last match's result line, ready for a rematch
checklist.assert: menu script: assert_substate Lobby after the probe's done signal, then dump_lobby

checklist.what: the host readies again in the rematch lobby and the seats reset
the client leaves and lands on the landing panel; the host's lobby shows the seat open again
checklist.assert: menu script: activate ButtonMultiplayerLeave then assert_substate Landing
